title: TLA+ Examples
summary: A collection of TLA+ specifications and models covering applications in several fields. The repository serves as an example library, a corpus for TLA+ tooling development and testing, and a set of formal specification case studies.

license.attribution: The repository license names the TLA+ project and other contributors.

reuse: Browse README.md to choose a specification and verification tool. Each specification directory carries a manifest; run a model with its included configuration using the tool indicated in the README or manifest.

project_details.setup: Use the README to find specifications, supported verification tools and model features. Follow the selected specification's model configuration and manifest.
